_readme: Questions for Bible subjects. Asked only when the series writes "checklist": {"packs": ["scripture"]} in series.json.

rules.ask: Has every verse in the film been checked against the exact text of the translation you use? Where the translation's units differ from the original's, is there a note?
Does the script have facts that are not in the source article? If so, where does each one come from?
Have you watched every generated shot, one by one? Do ancient people look right for their time, is Jesus drawn with a face, is there garbled text in the picture? Which shots did you regenerate?
Which beats are estimates, analogies or reconstructions? Are they all labeled on screen?
